predecessor_records_preserved_verbatim.verified_title: Bayesian Deep Ensembles via the Neural Tangent Kernel
predecessor_records_preserved_verbatim.exact_read_scope: READ_SCOPES.json:ntkgp; section 2, relevant section 3 prose/equations and Algorithm 1, sections 3.4-3.5, Appendices F-H and scoped I recipe paragraphs; no full proof or table audit
predecessor_records_preserved_verbatim.saved_takeaway: Adds a random untrainable function delta(x)=J(theta0,x)theta_star to every independently initialized learner, zeroing the auxiliary final-readout parameters. Jacobian-based ensemble construction and matching initial output second moments to classification scale are established.
source_findings: train_utils.py implements final-leaf zeroing and a fixed-primal JVP added to each prediction
train.py trains a scalar-readout toy model with MSE and anchored regularization
README documents toy_1d_example.ipynb; requirements pin JAX 0.1.70, jaxlib 0.1.47, neural-tangents 0.2.0
Inspected prediction closure evaluates its fixed-primal JVP during forwards; no explicit fixed-data JVP cache construction was found in the inspected train path
predecessor_records_preserved_verbatim.relationship: A close prior for using predictive Jacobians to construct ensemble functions. The current graph-filtered-error private-factor step differs from an additive frozen prior function, but this scoped difference is not global novelty evidence.
limits: Exact posterior statement assumes infinite width, NTK dynamics and squared loss
Classification uses one-hot regression, validation temperature scaling and target-scale tuning
Independent full learners and additive functions are not the finite shared-factor CE model
Pinned toy JAX source is not a qualified modern graph runner
Appendix G's JVP cost rule is a stated rule of thumb, not a measurement on 18.77
predecessor_records_preserved_verbatim.disposition: Do not claim frozen-Jacobian ensemble construction, output scale matching or a posterior interpretation as new
